description: Engine-protocol parity fixture (integration contract §3.1, §3.2, §3.4): jobs and results. Read by packages/domain/test/vcrEngineJob.test.mjs and by the engine case N00 (tests/numeric/N00_protocol.R, through tests/helpers/emit-job-verdicts.mjs). `valid` jobs are engine-facing jobs that validate clean. `validResults` / `invalidResults` are the same for results (`validateEngineResult`). `invalid` jobs each carry `expected`: issues written as "code@field" that must all appear in the verdict; the engine compares its whole verdict, sorted, with the domain module's.
